one_liner: Nifty 50 rises for the fourth session, driven by FMCG and Pharma gains.

drivers.title: Pharma Surge
drivers.detail: Nifty Pharma gained 1.16% with no specific catalyst.

drivers.title: FMCG Gains
drivers.detail: Nifty FMCG rose 0.95% amid broad sector strength.

drivers.title: Crude Oil Drop
drivers.detail: Brent and WTI crude prices fell sharply.

drivers.title: Mixed Breadth
drivers.detail: Market breadth was negative with more declines than advances.

flows_line: FIIs were net sellers with Rs 576.2 crore outflow; DIIs bought Rs 2,797.27 crore.
watch_next: Tomorrow's session includes NIFTY options expiry and ECB President Lagarde's speech.
lesson_seeds: FMCG and Pharma sectors led gains without specific catalysts.
Crude oil prices significantly impact market sentiment.
Market breadth can be negative even with index gains.
Institutional flows show divergent FII and DII activities.
